slides.title: Paws & Pause
slides.description: Opening brand title card introducing Paws & Pause as a cozy life-sim about a child earning toward adopting a puppy — a short, low-stakes pause after work or school.
slides.main_idea: Introduce the game and its emotional promise.
slides.visual: Large brand title with paw-print mark, warm paper gradient, soft SVG paw constellation / town vignette.
slides.narration: Meet Paws and Pause — a cozy little game about a kid, a small town, and one very big dream: a puppy of their very own.

slides.title: A kid, a town, one big dream
slides.description: Premise: puppies cost money, so the child works and saves; adoption starts the real care loop. Also establishes the game as a calm, universally welcoming pause after work or school.
slides.main_idea: Earn money first; adoption is the beginning — built as a calm pause for everyone.
bullets: A calm pause for every gender, every age
slides.visual: Custom HTML/CSS/SVG town illustration with shelter window and child silhouette — no stock photos.
slides.narration: Puppies aren't free. So our kid works, saves, and waits. When adoption day comes — that's where the real game begins. Built for after-work calm — for everyone.

slides.title: The daily rhythm
slides.description: Core gameplay loop as four numbered beats: explore/work, earn, care/decorate, rest/unlock.
slides.main_idea: One gentle daily loop: earn, spend, care, rest, repeat.
slides.visual: Numbered loop cards in a clean grid with SVG icons.
slides.narration: Every day follows the same gentle rhythm: wake up, explore, work a job, play a mini-game, care for the puppy, decorate, then rest — and do it again tomorrow.

slides.title: Adopt. Care. Feel.
slides.description: AI photo-match adoption at the shelter: take a selfie, get a puppy suited to your personality, then daily care with visible mood faces and Bond that only grows — plus Mii-style customization.
slides.main_idea: Photo-match your puppy, care for it daily, and grow your look together.
bullets: Take a photo — AI finds your match
Feed, walk, play — see the mood face
Mii-style looks for kid and puppy
slides.visual: Three feature cards with SVG icons for photo booth match, mood face, and customization.
slides.narration: At the shelter, take a photo — AI matches you with the puppy that fits your personality. Then care for it daily. Watch its mood on its face — Happiness rises and dips, but Bond only grows.

slides.title: Play more. Wake up informed.
slides.description: Example mini-games with more coming. Morning board: AI tarot fortune + weather, island news of the day (events), and AI-simplified important world news.
slides.main_idea: Growing mini-games, plus a morning board for fortune, island events, and easy world news.
slides.visual: Compact example activity row plus a three-panel morning board: fortune, island events, world digest.
slides.narration: Café, fishing, karts, and arcade are just examples — more games are coming. Each morning, check island events, draw a tarot card, and get an AI summary of important world news — short and easy to understand.

slides.title: A home. A dog. A little pause.
slides.description: Closing emotional thesis with centered paw mark, reinforcing the game as a relaxing daily pause.
slides.main_idea: End on the thesis: a small, calm world to come home to.
slides.visual: Centered paw-print mark with warm fade and short closing line.
slides.narration: A home. A dog. A little pause in your day. This is Paws and Pause.
